questions.q: From whom did the Colossians learn the Good News?
What does Paul say the Father delivered us out of?
According to Paul, in whom are all things held together?
What does Paul say he fills up in his flesh for the sake of the assembly?
options: What is lacking of Christ's afflictions
What was missing from the law
What the other apostles left undone
What the Colossians failed to give

questions.q: The riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, ____.
He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, ____.
Through him God reconciled all things to himself, having made peace through ____.

items: Thanks for their faith, love, and hope
Prayer to be filled with knowledge of his will
He is the image of the invisible God

questions.q: Paul says all things were created through Christ and for him.
Paul says the mystery was openly known through all past ages and generations.
What does Paul say was nailed to the cross?
options: The handwriting in ordinances against us
The stone tablets of the law
The sins of the Gentiles only

questions.q: What does Paul call feast days, new moons, and Sabbath days?
options: A shadow of the things to come

questions.q: What does Paul warn could rob them, after the tradition of men?
Besides Colossae, which city does Paul name as he describes his struggle for them?
For in him all the fullness of the Deity ____.
The mystery of God, of the Father and of Christ, in whom all the treasures of ____ are hidden.
Don't handle, nor taste, nor touch; all of which ____.

items: Walk in Christ as you received him
Let no one judge you about food or feasts

questions.q: Paul says that though he is absent in the flesh, he is with them in spirit.
Paul says harsh rules against the body are of great value against the indulgence of the flesh.
Where does Paul tell believers to set their minds?
What does Paul call love, which they are to walk in above all things?
What does Paul say should rule in their hearts?
Which of these pairs appears in Paul's list of distinctions that don't exist in the new man?
Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in ____, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
questions.answer: the name of the Lord Jesus

questions.q: For you died, and your life is ____.
Fathers, don't provoke your children, so that ____.

items: Put to death your earthly members
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly
Wives, be in subjection to your husbands

questions.q: Paul tells husbands to love their wives and not be bitter against them.
Paul says to forgive each other, even as the apostles forgave you.
What does Paul ask them to pray that God will open for him?
Whom does Paul call the beloved physician?
Who is Paul sending along with Tychicus?
What does Paul tell the Colossians to do once this letter has been read?
options: Have it read in the Laodicean assembly

questions.q: Let your speech always be with grace, ____, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
Masters, give to your servants what is just and equal, knowing that you also have ____.
Tell Archippus, Take heed to ____ which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.

items: Tychicus will make known Paul's affairs
Greet Nymphas and the assembly in his house

questions.q: Paul writes the closing greeting with his own hand and asks them to remember his chains.
Paul describes Mark as the brother of Barnabas.
